name: RoboCup 2D Soccer Simulation League
description: RoboCup offers a set of benchmark problems for Artificial Intelligence in form of official world championships since 1997. The most tactical advanced and richest in terms of behavioural complexity of these is the 2D Soccer Simulation League, a simulated robotic soccer competition. BetaRun is a new attempt combining both machine learning and manual programming approaches, with the ultimate goal to arrive at a team that is trained entirely from observing and playing games, and a new development based on agent2D.
reputation: A long-standing and highly respected robotics/AI benchmark with an active international competition and strong community recognition.
notes: Highly dynamic multi-agent environment; performance depends on team composition, simulator settings, and opponent strength. Scores are not directly comparable across eras due to changing rules, agents, and competition formats.
